Passive-targeting systems in the table at or above the threshold are the following, each listed with its drug delivery and particle size:
- KRAS siRNA TGF-β, particle size ~180 nm[1]
- VEGFR2 siRNA mTOR, particle size ~150 nm[2]
- siTEAD4 (MOF@EVs), particle size ~168 nm[3]
- DDP (VEGF target), particle size ~485 nm[4]

The largest of these is the DDP system, with a particle size of ~485 nm[5]. The other passive-targeting entries fall below the threshold, for example the HMME siYTHDF1 system at 139.83 nm[6]. The VEGFR2 entry is included because its size is stated as approximately the threshold, and it is not clearly above it.
